Scenario: multi-turn history replay (oracle iter_conversation_payloads
history skip). The request history (WithRequestMessages) contains one prior
assistant message "Earlier answer."; the stream re-sends it as a full message
add before the new turn. The replayed add must produce NO delta — it is
matched against the expected history and clears the text accumulator — while
the fresh message (m-2) + append stream "New answer". Final text is exactly
"New answer", never "Earlier answer.New answer".
